interface.signature: def leastInterval(N: int, K: int, tasks: List[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is between 1 and 10,000.
The cooldown period K is between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(task in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for task in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task is an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The minimum unit of time required to complete all tasks is at least the number of tasks N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(max((count - 1) * (K + 1) + 1 for count in Counter(tasks).values()), N + sum((count - 1) * K for count in Counter(tasks).values() if count > 1))
postconditions.description: The minimum unit of time required to complete all tasks is calculated based on the most frequent task and the cooldown period K.
